svg.title: Processing decisions and review
svg.desc: 1. Select laboratory source and mapped fields; 2. Full FHIR validation selected?; 3. Aggregate the complete semantic set; 4. A1: check source meaning, then cross-field plausibility; 5a. Optional A2: lookup proposals; 5b. Optional A3: study evidence; 6. Review the complete set

g.text: 1. Select laboratory source and mapped fields
Laboratory: code/system + name + specimen/method + value/statistics + unit/system + references
One pipeline.toml selects sources from catalog.csv; downloads stay under local/
Preflight checks roles, types, paths, count semantics, source/profile editions and configured services
2. Full FHIR validation selected?
Complete resource export → local validator + pinned profile → separate OperationOutcome
Then use the same semantic adapter for scalar or native FHIR data
3. Aggregate the complete semantic set
distinct: individual CSV / FHIR / DB values → n, mean, sample SD / SE, min / max, median / IQR
Pool supplied disjoint summaries; keep reference context. Optional items mode serves A1 inspection.
4. A1: check source meaning, then cross-field plausibility
Exact code/system and unit evidence → name/axes/specimen fit → code–unit compatibility
Check finite values, reference order/context and supported whole-set transformations
Write original A1 CSV + evidence/audit; valid, inconsistent and unresolved findings remain explicit
5a. Optional A2: lookup proposals
Grouped A1 report → candidates/pages → local model
Verify selected code/name/unit against actual terminology
Record proposal, sources and unresolved context
5b. Optional A3: study evidence
Grouped A1 report → screened Europe PMC / PubMed
Local extraction → exact quote/analyte/number/unit guards
Retain statistic, interval, context and source
6. Review the complete set
HTML field table / scalar CSV: source → finding → recommendation, with sources and status
Verify specimen, assay, population, unit conversion and each reference interval
Clinician approves / rejects / defers; source data is retained
Reuse compatible approved laboratory mappings after rechecking targets and factors
